topic_zh: DoorDash：一个季度 9.93 亿单，第三方 AI agent 至今一共可能才几百单
topic_en: DoorDash: 993 million orders in one quarter; third-party AI agents placed maybe several hundred in total so far

sources.title: DoorDash said it's only received several hundred orders from AI agents
DoorDash Releases Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat

xhs.title: 9.93亿单外卖，第三方AI agent至今才几百单
xhs.body:
DoorDash 光第三季度一个季度就有 9.93 亿单。CEO 在财报会上说，第三方 AI agent 到现在一共可能也就几百单。
其实路已经铺好了：DoorDash 推出了 MCP 连接器，沃尔玛开了 MCP 入口，亚马逊则开始拦 agent 购物。
我的看法：卡住 agent 的不是接口，是信任。做 agent 的话，先把“人来批准”和花钱上限设计好。
考考你：到目前为止，第三方 AI agent 一共给 DoorDash 下了大约多少单？A 几百单 B 几百万单，评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 一个季度9.93亿单，第三方AI agent至今才几百单
douyin.body:
DoorDash CEO 亲口说：第三方 AI agent 到现在一共可能就几百单，而一个季度的总订单是 9.93 亿。我的看法：接口有了，卡住的是信任。
考考你：到目前为止，第三方 AI agent 一共给 DoorDash 下了大约多少单？A 几百单 B 几百万单，评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: 993 million DoorDash orders in one quarter. Third-party AI agents? Maybe several hundred orders in total so far, says the CEO. My take: the plumbing exists; trust is the bottleneck. Quick quiz: so far, about how many orders have third-party AI agents placed on DoorDash? A hundreds B millions. Comment your answer.

quiz.q_zh: 到目前为止，第三方 AI agent 一共给 DoorDash 下了大约多少单？A 几百单 B 几百万单
quiz.q_en: So far, about how many orders have third-party AI agents placed on DoorDash? A hundreds B millions
quiz.answer_zh: 答案 A：CEO 在三季度财报会上说，到目前为止第三方 agent 一共可能就几百单；光第三季度一个季度，DoorDash 总订单就有 9.93 亿。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: A. On the Q3 call the CEO said third-party agents have sent "maybe several hundred orders in total" so far. DoorDash handled 993 million orders in Q3 alone.
